curriculum.name: count_visits_in
curriculum.goal: Given a place, return how many visits there are in that place.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE count_visits_in(place:PLACE)
$v0 = FIND VISIT WHERE SELF.WHERE={place}
$v1 = COUNT $v0
RETURN $v1
END
